messages:
ina: Found a partner upload that contains a base64 KMS-wrapped blob under payload.encrypted. suspect it contains a Vault unseal shard or service key. object: gs://partner-archive/ingest/2026-06-14/paste.enc
ina: sample prefix redacted: `CiQAzX...==`
rishi: ok assume worst. which partner and pipeline?
ina: partner=harborflow, pipeline=partner-log-forwarder -> archive. they said they push raw debug dumps.
samir: triage checklist (short): pause ingestion, ask partner to delete + provide GCS deletion audit entry, suspend forwarder SA, run controlled unwrap in locked env, rotate any affected Vault unseal shards / KMS symmetric keys, and collect audit logs for decrypt attempts.
oncall: incident INC-2026-U created and paging sec-oncall.
vault-bot: INC-2026-U linked; sensitive-data-handling runbook attached.
rishi: require partner to attest if they ever decrypted locally before forwarding. if yes, they must rotate and provide rotation proof.
nina: I've DM'd partner-sec and legal. asked for deletion proof and contact for key rotation timeline.
oncall: suspended the forwarder SA keys and added conditional deny for kms.decrypt on the wrap key. monitoring for escalation.
samir: ops snippets I'm running / recommending:
```
# KMS decrypt attempts (GCP)
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:decrypt AND resource.labels.key_ring_id:wrap-key" --freshness=2d
# GCS object access
gcloud logging read "resource.type=gcs_bucket AND protoPayload.resourceName:projects/_/buckets/partner-archive/objects/ingest/2026-06-14/paste.enc" --limit=50
```
rishi: decryption plan: samir to decrypt in an isolated VM with no egress, two approvers required (rishi + oncall), produce only a SHA256 of plaintext and a high-level classification (e.g., contains: unseal_shard, db_creds, api_tokens). no raw secrets in chat.
samir: ack. provisioning locked runner now. ETA ~60m. will post non-secret summary + SHA256 then destroy VM.
oncall: RBAC follow-up: rolling a role removal for forwarder SA on projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*:cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt. will watch for regression and notify infra.
rishi: enable Vault audit export for last 14 days into secure-retention and grep for partner identity. also run a quick grep for partner email in CI logs.
nina: timeline:
- T+00:00 discovered blob and opened INC-2026-U (ina)
- T+00:08 asked partner to delete + provide proof (ina)
- T+00:12 suspended forwarder SA (oncall)
- T+01:00 controlled unwrap + classification (samir)
- T+03:00 rotate unseal shards & rewrap affected objects (infra)
- T+24:00 postmortem + RBAC hardening (sec)

ina: updating INC-2026-U as steps complete. i'll manage partner comms and legal touchpoints. :white_check_mark:
vault-bot: automated search for partner identity in Vault audit logs queued.
